correctness.rationale: Covering inequalities force q points and q−1 lines at optimum. Maximal q²+1 line coverage forces selected points onto a line (order-two case handled separately). Separate exhaustive C++17/Python checks succeed for q=2,3,4.

value.rationale: Optimal sensor placements on finite incidence networks are naturally reconfigured with temporary size forbidden. New exact family-wide exchange graph has a growing interval in which movement is restricted to a parallel class before an abrupt global connectivity threshold 2q−2. The order-two and -three exceptions are fully characterized; result includes all non-Desarguesian planes. This is not merely a numerical domination bound.
